stories.title: Build ShipPulse data store and unit tests
stories.acceptance: Create src/lib/db/store.ts exporting createStore(env?: NodeJS.ProcessEnv): ShipPulseStore matching src/shared/types.ts and src/server.ts. Seed feat-1 ('Live Terminal Stream', in_progress, 42 votes, authorId 'seed'), feat-2 ('Automated RLS Checks', shipped, 19 votes, authorId 'seed'), and 1 initial changelog entry. Implement listFeatures, createFeature, toggleUpvote (per featureId:userId toggle returning {feature,voted} or null), listChangelogs, and publishChangelog; set mode to 'supabase' if env has SUPABASE_URL else 'local'. Add src/lib/db/store.test.mjs with 2 node:test tests covering seeded counts + upvote toggle (42->43->42) and feature/changelog creation.

stories.title: Build ShipPulse JSON API routes and unit tests
stories.acceptance: Create src/app/api/routes.ts exporting handleApiRoute(req, res, store, user): Promise<boolean> matching src/server.ts. Handle GET/POST /api/features ({title} -> 201 {ok:true,item}, 400 on blank title), POST /api/votes ({featureId} -> 200 {ok:true,feature,voted}, 404 if missing), and GET/POST /api/changelogs ({title,body,featureId} -> 201 {ok:true,entry}, 400 if invalid); return false for unknown paths. Add src/app/api/routes.test.mjs with 2 node:test tests covering feature/vote endpoints and changelog endpoints.

stories.title: Build dark Matrix board components and page
stories.acceptance: Create dark Matrix UI in src/components/board.ts (#0B0E0C background, #EEF2EF text, Matrix green accents, HTML-escaped cards) and src/app/board/page.ts exporting renderBoardPage(items: FeatureItem[], user: SessionUser | null): string matching src/server.ts DOM contracts: .sp-card[data-id] with .upvote-btn[data-id] and .vote-count, #feature-form, #feature-title, #feature-submit, #feature-list, and #nav-changelog (href='/changelog'). Include client JS sending x-demo-user header ('u-demo:builder@example.com:user' or active user) to POST /api/votes and POST /api/features, updating .vote-count and appending new .sp-card items. Add src/app/board/page.test.mjs with 2 node:test tests asserting dark Matrix markup/DOM selectors and x-demo-user header usage.

stories.title: Build dark Matrix changelog page and unit tests
stories.acceptance: Create src/app/changelog/page.ts exporting renderChangelogPage(entries: ChangelogEntry[]): string matching src/server.ts and dark Matrix styling from src/components/board.ts, including #nav-board (href='/') and #changelog-list rendering escaped title, body, featureId, and publishedAt. Add src/app/changelog/page.test.mjs with 2 node:test tests verifying #changelog-list/#nav-board rendering and HTML escaping.

stories.title: Build session guard, middleware, and auth tests
stories.acceptance: Create src/app/auth/guard.ts and src/middleware.ts exporting resolveSession(req) and checkAuthMiddleware(user, method, pathname) matching src/server.ts. Parse x-demo-user header '<id>:<email>:<role>' (role 'user'|'admin') into SessionUser|null. Allow all GET requests; require authenticated user (401) for POST /api/features and POST /api/votes; require admin role (401 unauth, 403 non-admin) for POST /api/changelogs. Add tests/e2e/auth.test.mjs with 2 node:test tests covering x-demo-user parsing and public/auth/admin route gating.

stories.title: Build headless Playwright E2E verification script
stories.acceptance: Edit ONLY scripts/e2e-shippulse.mjs. Start createShipPulseServer() on an ephemeral localhost port, launch playwright-core chromium with executablePath process.env.CHROME_PATH || '/usr/bin/google-chrome', track console/page/network errors, check /api/health modules, visit /, assert feat-1 upvote toggles 42->43->42 via .sp-card[data-id='feat-1'] .upvote-btn/.vote-count, submit 'Webhook Export' via #feature-form/#feature-title/#feature-submit and assert it renders in #feature-list, capture verify-shippulse.png, navigate via #nav-changelog to /changelog and assert #changelog-list renders, assert 0 errs, close browser and server, and print JSON {ok,modules,upvote,errs}.
